biotools.summary: Open Chrono-Morph Viewer is a Python-based tool for visualizing large, time-lapse 3D bioimage datasets with heterogeneous volume formats. It provides a user-friendly interface for morphological investigation and quantitative analysis with scriptable animation capabilities.
